description: Reads the profiled app's storage through its SDK, live (requires enabled Storage read permission): a SharedPreferences file (store "prefs": its keys in order with typed values, 500 at most per call; pass nextCursor back as cursor for more), a registered database's schema (store "db" without pages: tables with columns, primary key and why a table is read-only), or up to 4 table pages read in ONE transaction (store "db" with pages: [{table, columns?, cursor?, limit? (1-200, default 50)}], rows in primary key order, each with the digest a delete needs). Cursors are opaque tokens: pass a nextCursor back as it came (valid for that file or table while the app's link lasts). A page with truncated:true was cut to stay under the answer size (rows left out, or a row too large sent with its values cut): its nextCursor continues. On protocol 12, Storage values are original, including credentials; views and virtual tables remain read-only. Older SDKs redact values. Reading a database holds the app's writers while it runs (a 250 ms budget checked between statements, so a slow statement can run past it). The answer's "target" names the app link it came from: pass it to write_storage so an edit never goes to another app, process or link. Values are typed: {"t":"string"|"int"|"long"|"integer"|"float"|"real"|"bool"|"stringSet"|"blob"|"null", ...}. Integers are decimal strings (never numbers); float/real carry "bits" (raw IEEE bits, the exact value) and "v" (display only). {"t":"redacted"} values come from older SDK redaction and are not editable; protocol 12 returns original Storage values including credentials. complete:false values were cut: read-only. A prefs entry with "keyLength" has a key too long to send: "key" is only its first code units, read-only (written as a key, that prefix would name ANOTHER key). Use list_storage first for the names.

cursor.description: prefs only: nextCursor of the previous call (an opaque token)

name.description: The prefs file name (without .xml) or the registered database name (list_storage)

pages.description: db only: the table pages to read together; omitted: the schema

store.description: prefs: a SharedPreferences file; db: a registered database

name: read_storage
title: Read app storage
